title: Request Limits and Dispatch Timeouts, Wayfare Rides
content:
How many seats one request may be for, how many trips a rider may have open at once and how long dispatch searches for a driver are set per ride option of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**.

| Limit | Wayfare Shared | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most seats one request may be for | 2 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 4 | 6 |
| Most open on-demand trips per rider at once | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Most open reserved trips per rider (scheduled or accepted) | 0 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 |
| On-demand dispatch timeout (minutes) | 6 | 8 | 8 | 10 | 10 | 12 | 12 |

## Definitions

- **Most seats one request may be for**, in seats.
- **Most open on-demand trips**: most on-demand trips one rider may have open (requested, accepted, driver arrived or in progress) at once, count.
- **Most open reserved trips**: most reserved trips one rider may hold in scheduled or accepted status at once, count.
- **On-demand dispatch timeout**: an on-demand request no driver accepts within this many minutes is closed as unfulfilled, minutes.

## Notes

- Wayfare XL and Wayfare Black SUV take requests for up to 6 seats; Wayfare Shared up to 2; the other ride options up to 4.
- A limit of 0 open reserved trips on Wayfare Shared matches the fact that Wayfare Shared is not offered through Wayfare Reserve.
